veranderings.na: het vir 'n loon by die VOC aangesluit
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans 'aansluit' normally needs 'by' and an object; the bare form reads like English 'signed on', and the VOC is already named in the sentence.

veranderings.blok: Min plek en werk in wagte
veranderings.voor: seemanne aan diens op die dek
veranderings.na: seemanne op die dek aan diens
veranderings.rede: The predicate-like phrase 'aan diens' sits more naturally at the end, after the place phrase.
'ná 'n ruk' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'ná 'n tyd' is a calque of 'after a time'.
